about_page.banner_description: Belaya Reka is more than just milk. It is a story of purity, trust, and care—born in the very heart of Kyrgyzstan. We believe that true quality starts with the right mindset: a commitment to our work, our people, and the land. That is why every morning we begin with confidence, knowing we are doing the right thing—creating products with nothing unnecessary, only what truly matters.

products_page.banner_description: Our product range is thoughtfully designed to meet the needs of every family: for breakfast, snacks, cooking, and desserts. Each product is made from natural ingredients, backed by strict quality control and carefully refined production technologies.

where_to_buy_page.banner_description: Belaya Reka products are available in retail chains and stores across Kyrgyzstan and are also distributed in Kazakhstan. We ensure wide availability so your favorite products are always within easy reach—in convenient formats and locations.

partnersCollab.title: Honesty
partnersCollab.descr: We build partnerships on transparent terms: clear agreements, fulfillment of obligations, and timely payments. Open dialogue and predictability are the foundation of long-term cooperation.

partnersCollab.title: Openness
partnersCollab.descr: We are open to constructive communication, discussion of terms, and joint development. We provide necessary information about products, volumes, and logistics, ensuring transparency at all stages of interaction.

companyCart.title: Products
companyCart.descr: Our specialty is the production of butter, fermented dairy, and oxygen-enriched products from pure raw materials.

companyCart.title: Production
companyCart.descr: In 2012, a new building with modern equipment for processing and packaging dairy products was constructed on the factory premises. The enterprise operates in a full-cycle mode.

companyCart.title: Quality
companyCart.descr: The high quality of our products is confirmed by the international standard ISO 22000 «Food Safety Management Systems» and the «Halal» certificate.

values.title: Quality
values.descr: Only selected milk with impeccable indicators is used for production. When producing tasty and healthy products, we take care to preserve all beneficial properties. Our credo is naturalness in every product.

values.title: Naturalness
values.descr: Naturalness in every sip. We add nothing unnecessary and hide nothing simple. Belaya Reka milk is what nature intended: fresh, clean and real, like our land itself.

values.title: Openness
values.descr: The farms keep exemplary purebred animals cared for by some of the best specialists in the country. Vitamin-rich feed and modern animal husbandry methods allow us to obtain the highest grade milk with impeccable nutritional indicators.

values.title: Honesty
values.descr: Our dairy products are an example of responsible attitude to production. Using the highest grade raw milk, we guarantee only a clean composition, natural taste and maximum benefit of all ingredients.

values.title: Reliability
values.descr: The farms keep exemplary purebred animals cared for by some of the best specialists in the country. Our credo is quality from field to shelf.

proud.title: Factories
proud.descr: 3 milk processing plants in the Chui and Issyk-Kul regions are equipped with state-of-the-art technology and are steadily increasing production volumes.

proud.title: Team
proud.descr: The team consists of thousands of specialists united by love for their work, respect for traditions, continuous development and mastering of advanced global experience.

steps.label: Milk Production
steps.description: We collect raw milk from local farmers across Kyrgyzstan. We work with trusted farms and build long-term partnerships.

steps.label: Milk Collection
steps.description: Each batch of raw materials undergoes mandatory laboratory tests. Quality and safety indicators are checked. Only upon full compliance with standards is the raw material allowed for further processing.

steps.label: Milk Processing
steps.description: Depending on the product category, appropriate technological stages are applied: pasteurization, normalization, fermentation and other processes. All operations are carried out in compliance with temperature conditions and quality standards.

steps.label: Quality Control
steps.description: Finished products are packaged on modern equipment in compliance with sanitary standards. Packaging ensures safety, security and ease of use.

steps.label: On the store shelf
steps.description: Products are placed in the finished goods warehouse in compliance with temperature conditions and storage requirements until shipment.

products.title: Products
products.description: We specialize in the production of butter, fermented dairy products, and oxygen-enriched dairy products made from pure, natural ingredients.

production.title: Production
production.description: In 2012, a new facility equipped with modern processing and packaging technology was built on the plant's premises. Today, the company operates as a fully integrated, full-cycle enterprise.

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: The consistently high quality of our products is confirmed by the international ISO 22000 “Food Safety Management Systems” standard and Halal certification.

honesty.title: Integrity
honesty.descr: We build partnerships on transparent terms: clear agreements, meeting our commitments, and timely payments. Open dialogue and predictability form the foundation of long-term cooperation.

openness.title: Transparency
openness.descr: We are always open to constructive dialogue, discussing terms, and growing together. We provide full information about our products, volumes, and logistics, ensuring transparency at every stage.

reliability.title: Reliability
reliability.descr: Our own production facilities and robust logistics enable us to ensure a stable supply and timely delivery. We value consistency and responsibility in working with distributors and retail chains.
